Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تَشَأْ تَعْفُ عَنَّا فَبِفَضْلِكَ
Translation: O Allah, if You wish to pardon us, it is by Your grace

Arabic text: وَإِنْ تَشَأْ تُعَذِّبْنَا فَبِعَدْلِكَ فَسَهِّلْ لَنَا عَفْوَكَ بِمَنِّكَ
Translation: And if You wish to punish us, it is by Your justice, so make Your pardon easy for us by Your favor

Arabic text: وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ بِتَجَاوُزِكَ فَإِنَّهُ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِعَدْلِكَ
Translation: And protect us from Your punishment by Your forbearance, for we have no strength to bear Your justice

Arabic text: وَلَا نَجَاةَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَّا دُوْنَ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: And there is no salvation for any of us without Your pardon

Arabic text: يَا غَنِيَّ الْأَغْنِيَاءِ هَا نَحْنُ عِبَادُكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
Translation: O Most Wealthy of the wealthy, here we are, Your servants, before You

Arabic text: وَأَنَا أَفْقَرُ الْفُقَرَاءِ إِلَيْكَ فَاجْبُرْ فَاقَتَنَا بِوُسْعِكَ
Translation: And I am the poorest of the poor before You, so remedy our poverty by Your abundance

Arabic text: وَلَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَاءَنَا بِمَنْعِكَ فَتَكُونَ قَدْ أَشْقَيْتَ مَنِ اسْتَسْعَدَ بِكَ
Translation: And do not cut off our hope by Your refusal, for then You would have made wretched those who sought happiness through You

Arabic text: وَحَرَمْتَ مَنِ اسْتَرْفَدَ فَضْلَكَ
Translation: And deprived those who sought Your bounty

Arabic text: فَإِلَى مَنْ حِيْنَئِذٍ مُنْقَلَبُنَا عَنْكَ
Translation: Then to whom would we turn away from You?

Arabic text: وَإِلَى أَيْنَ مَذْهَبُنَا عَنْ بَابِكَ
Translation: And where would we go away from Your door?

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ نَحْنُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ الَّذِيْنَ أَوْجَبْتَ إِجَابَتَهُمْ
Translation: Glory be to You! We are the distressed ones whose prayers You have promised to answer

Arabic text: وَأَهْلُ السُّوءِ الَّذِيْنَ وَعَدْتَ الْكَشْفَ عَنْهُمْ
Translation: And the people in adversity from whom You have promised to remove harm

Arabic text: وَأَشْبَهُ الْأَشْيَاءِ بِمَشِيَّتِكَ
Translation: And the most fitting of things with Your will

Arabic text: وَأَوْلَى الْأُمُورِ بِكَ فِيْ عَظَمَتِكَ رَحْمَةُ مَنِ اسْتَرْحَمَكَ
Translation: And the most worthy affairs for You in Your greatness is to show mercy to one who asks for Your mercy

Arabic text: وَغَوْثُ مَنِ اسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ، فَارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعَنَا إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And to help one who seeks Your help. So have mercy on our imploring You

Arabic text: وَأَغْنِنَا إِذْ طَرَحْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
Translation: And free us from need when we have thrown ourselves before You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ شَمِتَ بِنَا إِذْ شَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, Satan has rejoiced at our following him in disobeying You

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَلَا تُشْمِتْهُ بِنَا بَعْدَ تَرْكِنَا إِيَّاهُ لَكَ
Translation: And do not let him rejoice at us after we have abandoned him for You

Arabic text: وَرَغْبَتِنَا عَنْهُ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And turned away from him towards You
